task: query-analysis stage (intent classification + search-term extraction) then real hybrid search
accuracy_metric: retrieval fidelity vs the current baseline's ranked document IDs (pseudo-gold regression); lower agreement means divergence, not necessarily worse absolute accuracy
caveat: reranker returned HTTP 401 (auth) for all methods, so ranking is raw hybrid order; this matches current production behavior but makes ranking more sensitive to keyword differences

techniques.M1: call fusion (classify+preparation merged into one call)
techniques.M2: M1 + model right-sizing (gpt-oss-20b instead of gemma-4-31B, reasoning_effort=low)

conclusion: app-level acceleration trades retrieval fidelity: fusion alone (M1) is 1.3x at recall 0.885; aggressive stacking (M3/M4) reaches 7.5x but recall 0.55. Search amplifies small extraction differences, so accuracy-preserving speedup requires serving-level decode acceleration (fp8/tensor-parallel/speculative decoding) that keeps outputs identical.
